note: captured with a standalone script hitting the real endpoint with jev.NewGate's exact request shape (mirrors v1 record section 1); Authorization header redacted before saving anywhere. The question text ('休暇申請書を印刷したい') is m44 from the mid corpus, sent here against an illustrative 3-endpoint inventory shortlist rather than the real 30-operation mid subset, to keep the example short; m44's own real run (mid-default-gate.log) scored noul 0.86 against its real 20-endpoint post-narrowing shortlist - both comfortably above the 0.7 threshold, so the picker/service composition of the shortlist does not change the qualitative reading of this example.
